title: Bloomberg is making its ASKB conversational AI interface available to all Terminal users, letting them integrate their own content with existing financial data (Steven Rosenbush/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Steven Rosenbush / Wall Street Journal: Bloomberg is making its ASKB conversational AI interface available to all Terminal users, letting them integrate their own content with existing financial data — Allowing users to add their own information to the company's generative AI-based ASKB interface will feed the system with a new level of context
